decision_basis: No conservative provider-token upper bound established for canonical JSONUTF8bytes+2048 on any of the five exact roles.
Outputschema can add billable provider content; roleinput limits are local controls, not transmitted provider limits.
Default groupingwrites have documented pricing but no supported exact-route settlement in current code.
negative_scope: This does not prove no possible bound exists. It establishes no-go for the unchanged controls from reviewed code and current primary documentation.
